summary: TIM S.A. filed its 2Q26 earnings results via Form 6-K, a routine foreign private issuer report. The release details sequential and year-over-year financial and operational improvements, including service revenue growth, margin expansion, mobile ARPU, and B2B service revenue. It mentions the acquisition of I-Systems in the context of FTTH strategy but provides no deal terms, premium, or target details. The filing also announces shareholder remuneration as interest on capital. There is no special-situation event; the filing is a standard quarterly update with no new M&A, activist, or restructuring activity.
